thomas-imaging.longDescription: I'm a Registration Specialist at WVU Medicine’s Thomas Imaging Center. The patients come in, and I register them. That registration runs in Epic.

thomas-imaging.takeaway2: The place is WVU Medicine Thomas Imaging Center.
thomas-imaging.takeaway3: Epic is the system the registration runs in.
thomas-imaging.result: It's the day job next to the business I own.
thomas-imaging.seoDescription: I'm a Registration Specialist at WVU Medicine Thomas Imaging Center. Patient registration runs in Epic.

comptia-a-plus.longDescription: I earned CompTIA A+ in October 2025. It expires in October 2028. The badge is CompTIA’s organization badge on Credly.
comptia-a-plus.approach: This is the credential I point at when the work is hardware, Windows, and the troubleshooting that happens at a desk.
comptia-a-plus.seoDescription: I earned CompTIA A+ in October 2025. It expires in October 2028.

network-plus.description: The one for the path between machines.
network-plus.longDescription: I earned CompTIA Network+ in October 2025. It expires in October 2028. The badge is CompTIA’s organization badge on Credly.
network-plus.approach: When the problem leaves the desk and gets on a network, this is the credential that matches. Infrastructure, operations, troubleshooting.
network-plus.stackNote: Networking, TCP/IP, and Wi-Fi sit next to this one.
network-plus.seoDescription: I earned CompTIA Network+ in October 2025. It expires in October 2028.
